summary: Adds optional Budget rewards for finished days within your calorie range and AI help for creating foods and suggesting goals.

features.title: Budget reward
features.short: Reward a completed day within your calorie range in Budget
features.description:
The server owner can enable Budget rewards in Nutrition's app settings. Each Apps Hub profile then chooses an amount, one or more destination Budget categories, and an optional source category.

When Nutrition is opened, eligible finished days from the last seven days are checked against the profile's daily calorie range. Each chosen destination receives the reward once for an eligible day; an optional source funds each transfer. A day without food logged cannot earn a reward because the calorie range must have a positive lower bound.

Budget must be installed with its App API enabled in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs; this API is off by default. Without the Premium build, the desktop reward control opens the Premium prompt and the public page hides the feature. Food logging, recipes, goals and restrictions remain available.

features.title: AI help
features.short: Create a food or suggest goals with AI inside the app
features.description:
The server owner enables AI help in Nutrition's app settings. When adding food, a Create with AI button lets you describe a food in your own words; the AI returns a name, values per 100 g, a portion, allergens and labels. In Goals, Suggest with AI proposes calorie and nutrient goals and restrictions from your body data, your goal and an optional note such as lactose intolerance.

Everything is shown for review first. Nothing is saved until you confirm it, and a note states that this is not medical information and was generated by AI from the data you entered. Suggested restrictions are limited to the fixed labels and allergens.

mvmAI must be installed with its App API enabled in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs; this API is off by default. Each request can use credits, with the price set by the administrator in Apps Hub → Paid Apps; a request that fails is refunded. Without the Premium build, the desktop control opens the Premium prompt and the public page hides the feature.
